### Checklist

- [x] I searched related issues but found no solution.
- [x] The bug persists in the latest version.
- [ ] Issues without environment info and a minimal reproducible demo are hard to resolve and may receive no feedback.
- [ ] If this is not a bug report but a general question, please start a discussion at https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/discussions. Otherwise, it will be closed.
- [x] Please use English. Otherwise, it will be closed.

### Describe the bug

CustomOp.dispatch_forward() in python/sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/layers/custom_op.py maps the detected platform to a forward_<backend> method and caches it in __init__. Every backend in that table
has a base-class fallback — forward_hip/forward_cpu/forward_musa delegate to forward_cuda, and forward_tpu/forward_oot/forward_npu delegate to forward_native — so a subclass only needs to implement
forward_native to work on all of them.

The xpu branch is the one exception. At custom_op.py:83-84:

elif current_platform.is_xpu():
    return self.forward_xpu

but the base class never defines forward_xpu. On Intel XPU, any subclass without its own override raises AttributeError. Because dispatch_forward() is called from CustomOp.__init__ (custom_op.py:27),
this fires at construction time, not on first forward — so it breaks model loading, not inference, and no amount of input-shape or dtype variation avoids it.

### Reproduction

[repro_standalone.py
](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30637091/repro_standalone.py)
```
$ python repro_standalone.py
torch 2.12.0+xpu

detected backend : xpu
device           : xpu:0
dispatch target  : forward_xpu

[FAIL] dispatch table  dispatch table references undefined method(s): forward_xpu
[FAIL] construction    construction raised AttributeError: 'MyLayerNorm' object has no attribute 'forward_xpu'
```

### Environment

Intel XPU Environment : 
```
OS:            Linux-6.14.0-37-generic-x86_64-with-glibc2.41
Python:        3.13.12
PyTorch:       2.12.0+xpu
Accelerator:   xpu (torch._C._get_accelerator())
GPUs:          8× Intel(R) Arc(TM) Pro B60 Graphics
Backend:       xccl (oneCCL)
```

Nvidia GPU Environment : 
```
OS: Linux-5.15.0-1071-nvidia-x86_64-with-glibc2.39
Python: 3.12.3
PyTorch: 2.11.0a0+eb65b36914.nv26.02
CUDA (torch): 13.1
cuDNN: 91900
Accelerator:   cuda (torch._C._get_accelerator())
GPUs:          8× NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB
Backend:       nccl
```
title: [Bug] [multimodal_gen] CustomOp.dispatch_forward() XPU breaking model construction on Intel GPUs
